cleanup.postgres: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='zitadel' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid(); DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS zitadel; DROP USER IF EXISTS zitadel;

description: addon-ssl + addon-mtls: Zitadel presents its addon-mtls client certs over a verify-ca TLS connection. mtls_cns defaults (zitadel app property) to '<hostname>\npostgres', so addon-mtls issues two certs: User.SSL -> /certs/mtls/<hostname>/, Admin.SSL -> /certs/mtls/postgres/. Client-side only — depends on postgres/ssl (server SSL + password auth from the same root CA that verify-ca trusts); postgres-side client-cert verification is the separate postgres/mtls plan and out of scope here. conf-enable-mtls-app.sh splits zitadel.yaml Database User/Admin SSL to verify-ca + per-CN Cert/Key/RootCert, binds the certs volume into the zitadel-api service, and relaxes the mtls cert perms for the non-root zitadel-api user. stack_name='ssl' shares the postgres_ssl stack so the DB password matches the postgres/ssl dependency (cf. zitadel/reconf-ssl).
